direction: Inspired by prefecture and city conquest strategy games with round battle units and bright tabletop-style territorial warfare.
selected_concept: Nationwide node-link conquest across prefectures and major cities with auto-growing forces, visible front-line streams, and supply-cut tactics.
core_loop_signature: grow forces on owned nodes send round unit streams through connected prefectures cut reinforcement routes capture capitals and collapse the enemy front
differentiation_axes: graph-based territorial conquest instead of lane combat
supply isolation and route denial as primary tactical lever
bright atlas-board presentation instead of neon or military dashboards
round battle unit streams with directional facing and contact feedback
regional chapter structure with map-rule diversity
forbidden_template_reuse: no fixed three-lane side-view battle layout
no single repeated national map template across chapters
no placeholder circles without facing bounce recoil and capture feedback
no pure transport puzzle focus replacing conquest pressure

map_content_budget.play_area_model: connected prefecture and city graph maps with specialty nodes and alternate route links
map_content_budget.route_or_region_count: 40 campaign stages across 6 regional chapter sets with 8 to 18 nodes per stage
map_content_budget.interactive_regions: command capitals city nodes supply depots rail hubs ferry ports watchtowers and temporary neutral forts
map_content_budget.decorative_prop_count: at least 10 landmark families used across the campaign
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: single-screen authored maps with adaptive fit and optional mild pan for dense tablet layouts

special_rules: specialty nodes grant persistent in-match bonuses
regional modifiers alter route speed or growth behavior
elite commanders use stage-specific pressure patterns
risk_reward_systems: sending too many troops exposes backline
capturing bonus nodes can overextend the front
all-in surge can break stalemates or cause collapse
reserve-safe mode trades tempo for stability

asset_variety_budget.minimum_distinct_sprite_families: at least 6 primary token families plus region landmark families
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: round battle units are a mandatory identity pillar and must not degrade into generic colored dots during delivery-ready implementation
